judgments.reason: F-1017 records pump A at 9.2 barg against 11 barg design, without a measured flow; internal wear or a partly closed valve is suspected, not resolved. F-1003 separately records pump B's initial failed start. The domain notes require checking actual partner capability and warn that findings against both legs remove redundancy credit. Neither a successful start nor pump B's eventual rated pressure establishes a healthy full-design pump A. This is a known-fixture contradiction judgment, not certification of an alternative numeric impact.
